# Version 4.148.0
> **First stable v4 release** · Released June 22, 2026 · [NuGet](https://www.nuget.org/packages/SkiaSharp/4.148.0) · [GitHub Release](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/releases/tag/v4.148.0)

> **Supersedes [4.147.0](4.147.0.md)** · Rolls up preview-only work that was never released as stable — those changes are included cumulatively below.

> **API changes** · [SkiaSharp API diff](4.148.0/index.md) · [HarfBuzzSharp API diff](harfbuzzsharp/14.2.0/index.md)

## Highlights

SkiaSharp 4.148.0 is the first stable v4 release, built on Skia m148. It delivers variable fonts, color font palettes, animated WebP encoding, SKPathBuilder, explicit surface sampling, and corrected singleton and pixel-access lifecycles. This is a breaking release: review the migration notes before moving from v3.

## Breaking Changes

- **Legacy text, paint, sampling, and run-buffer APIs are compile errors** — Pre-v4 obsolete APIs are removed from the reference surface, including SKPaint text and font state, SKFilterQuality and SKPaintHinting, sample-count render-target constructors, and run-buffer span methods. Move text state to SKFont, filtering to SKSamplingOptions, and use the replacement properties and constructors named by each obsolete diagnostic. ([#4068](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4068), [#4114](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4114), [#4205](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4205))
- **Assembly version moves to 4.x** — SkiaSharp.dll now reports assembly version 4.148.0.0 instead of 3.119.0.0. Update strong-name binding redirects and any hard-coded assembly version checks. ([#4125](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4125))
- **Parameterless SKFont uses an empty typeface** — A parameterless SKFont no longer resolves the platform default while drawing; its typeface is SKTypeface.Empty, so text measures to zero and does not render. Construct SKFont with SKTypeface.Default when text should use the platform default. ([#3730](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3730))
- **Default typeface null semantics change** — New SKPaint instances expose SKTypeface.Default instead of null, missing family names return the default on Android, and SKTypeface.Default always returns a face or SKTypeface.Empty. Use SKFontManager.Default.MatchFamily when a strict missing-family null result is required, and use IsEmpty instead of null to detect an empty face. ([#3730](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3730))
- **SKStream.Move(long) rejects out-of-range offsets** — Move(long) is obsolete and now throws OverflowException instead of truncating values outside the 32-bit native range. Validate the offset and call Move(int).
- **Vulkan now requires version 1.1** — Creating a Ganesh Vulkan context against Vulkan 1.0 now terminates the process instead of returning null. Create the instance as Vulkan 1.1 or later and set GRVkBackendContext.MaxAPIVersion to the same supported version; use another backend on 1.0-only hardware. ([#3702](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3702))
- **Vulkan interop structures change** — GRVkBackendContextNative removes five legacy fields, and GRVkYcbcrConversionInfo becomes GRVkYcbcrConversionInfo with a new Components field and without the old value-equality members. Delete assignments to the removed fields, use the typed extension and device-feature fields, and update manual layouts and type references. ([#4001](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4001))
- **SKNativeObject.IgnorePublicDispose is read-only** — Subclasses can no longer change IgnorePublicDispose through its protected setter. Set the disposal policy through the appropriate constructor path instead. ([#4080](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4080))
- **WebAssembly native assets require .NET 8 or later** — Native assets for pre-.NET 8 Emscripten versions are removed. Move Blazor WebAssembly and Uno WebAssembly applications to .NET 8 or later before upgrading. ([#4022](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4022))
- **Tizen 32-bit native assets are removed** — The Skia m147 update drops Tizen arm and x86 native builds. Move Tizen deployments to arm64 or x64. ([#3702](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3702), [#3620](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3620))

## Engine

- **Skia advances from m132 through m148** — The bundled renderer moves across sixteen milestones, adopts immutable SkPath internals, and includes m147 optimizer, runtime-effect, and malformed-region fixes. — ❤️ [@ramezgerges](https://github.com/ramezgerges) ([#3560](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3560), [#3660](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3660), [#3702](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3702), [#4044](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4044), [#4125](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4125))

## API Surface

- **Variable fonts and color font palettes** — SKTypeface and HarfBuzzSharp expose variation axes, named instances, design coordinates, palette selection, and per-color overrides for variable and color fonts. — ❤️ [@ramezgerges](https://github.com/ramezgerges) ([#3703](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3703), [#3742](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3742))
- **SKPathBuilder and explicit sampling** — SKPathBuilder provides the new path mutation surface, while SKSurface, SKCanvas, and SKBitmap gain SKSamplingOptions overloads for explicit filtering. — ❤️ [@ramezgerges](https://github.com/ramezgerges) ([#3702](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3702), [#3491](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3491), [#4114](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4114))
- **Animated WebP and zero-copy stream data** — SKWebpEncoder writes animated frame sequences, and SKStream.GetData exposes backing SKData directly when the stream supports it. ([#3771](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3771), [#3772](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3772))
- **RF16 color and additional wrappers** — Adds the single-channel half-float SKColorType.RF16 plus XPS document options, per-resource GPU flushes, shader-backed mask filters, HBColor, and missing HarfBuzz wrappers. ([#4125](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4125), [#4000](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4000), [#4001](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4001))

## Bug Fixes

- **Pixel spans honor row stride and coordinates** — SKPixmap and SKBitmap GetPixelSpan now use RowBytes for shared-buffer subsets and calculate typed offsets from the correct image axis. ([#4128](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4128), [#4148](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4148))
- **Typeface and path crashes are fixed** — Managed default-typeface resolution avoids the Android API 36 startup crash, and SKPath finalization no longer dereferences a builder collected first. — ❤️ [@ramezgerges](https://github.com/ramezgerges) ([#3730](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3730), [#3744](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3744), [#3796](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3796))
- **WinUI projection loading works for .NET 9** — The WinUI projection assembly is packaged for both current and previous Windows target frameworks, preventing startup FileNotFoundException failures. ([#4084](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4084))
- **Android SKGLView resumes rendering after tab switches** — Reattaching an SKGLView in a MAUI TabBar no longer leaves the OpenGL view blank. — ❤️ [@SimonvBez](https://github.com/SimonvBez) ([#3076](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3076))

## Lifecycle & Internals

- **Process-wide singleton initialization and ownership are corrected** — Lazy per-type initialization removes the static-constructor cycle, shared native singletons are no longer freed by managed wrappers, and wrappers remain alive across native calls. — ❤️ [@ramezgerges](https://github.com/ramezgerges) ([#4080](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4080))
- **Native compatibility checks run on first interop use** — The compatibility gate moves from module load to the SkiaApi type initializer, allowing applications to configure native-library resolution before the first P/Invoke. ([#4133](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4133))

## Platform

- **Linux Bionic and 64-bit Tizen assets** — Adds linux-bionic native packages and Tizen arm64 and x64 builds while retiring Tizen's 32-bit targets. — ❤️ [@4Darmygeometry](https://github.com/4Darmygeometry), [@ramezgerges](https://github.com/ramezgerges) ([#3217](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3217), [#3620](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3620), [#3702](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3702))
- **Apple target frameworks accept the base 26.0 workload** — Library packages target the 26.0 Apple TFMs, while applications use unversioned TFMs so installed workloads select the matching SDK. ([#3798](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3798))

## Security

- **Expat updated with 2.8 security hardening** — The bundled XML parser moves to Expat 2.8.1 and incorporates the upstream release's security hardening. ([#4079](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4079))

## HarfBuzzSharp 14.2.0

Updates the bundled HarfBuzz engine from 8.3.1 to 14.2.0, adds variable-font and color-palette APIs, introduces HBColor, and fills gaps in the public wrappers.
